subject.title: fix(ci): run QA profile script lane alongside core scenarios

question: Should the maintainer-owned QA evidence workflow adopt this two-part execution and merge contract after its final required checks and an end-to-end workflow run confirm canonical artifact and failure semantics?
rationale: The patch changes an internal CI/maturity publishing boundary rather than product runtime code, but it is protected maintainer work and its downstream artifact contract cannot be fully established from the partial diff and in-progress checks alone.

options.title: Land after end-to-end confirmation
options.body: Confirm one successful profile run and one controlled partition failure preserve the canonical artifact and final failure semantics, then merge the current design.

options.title: Request a narrower workflow proof
options.body: Keep the PR open and ask for workflow logs or artifacts that demonstrate the merge job validates profile, SHA, and failed-partition outcomes before the publisher consumes evidence.

recommendation.title: Land after end-to-end confirmation
recommendation.body: Confirm one successful profile run and one controlled partition failure preserve the canonical artifact and final failure semantics, then merge the current design.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa authored the current maintainer-owned workflow change and supplied its validation rationale.
